'No exercise arm' is true: all 6 samples sedentary, checked via metadata, paper text and file list (one expression file). Wide enough. Flag refusal_vs_exercise_words is a false positive (growth_protocol husbandry text, no exercise).

summary: 拒绝分析的决定正确：GSE242294 只有未运动的 WT 与 miR-92b KO 腓肠肌各 3 个样本，没有运动组。论文阈值（原始 p<0.05，无倍数变化阈值，2165 个 DEG）被准确记录。机械标记 refusal_vs_exercise_words 为误报（仅饲养环境文字）。
